{{Quote|When you're a Jedi Master, you can make the plan.''"<br />"''That's just it. How can I become a Jedi Master if I'm always getting caught?''"<br />"''At least you're a master&hellip; at getting caught.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Dooku Captured" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place over and on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] attempted to capture [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] allowed himself to be taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] aboard [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|Dooku's frigate]] while in an [[Unidentified ice field/Legends|ice field]] and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] infiltrated the Confederate [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] when it was later in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over Vanqor, freeing his companion. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] found and confronted Dooku, but as the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] opened fire on the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] fled from the ship in his [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|solar sailer]].

Skywalker and Kenobi stole a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|transport shuttle]] and pursued the [[Count/Legends|count]], but both the Jedi and [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] ships were damaged and forced to crash-land on Vanqor. While Dooku trapped the Jedi in a cave and managed to escape, Skywalker and Kenobi fought and defeated a [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] before accidentally releasing noxious gas while trying to unblock the exit from the cave. The two Jedi were rescued by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]], when they blasted open the cavern entrance.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Master, we're approaching the ice field on schedule. I still say this is a ''dumb'' plan. The Separatists will ''never'' fall for it.''"<br />"''Ahsoka, those stupid battle droids will fall for ''anything''.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Bait" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Dooku Captured Date" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sought to capture [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in order to bring the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to a quicker end. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] devised a plan to capture the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]]: Skywalker would sneak aboard Dooku's [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|frigate]] and purposely allow himself to be captured<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> so that he could disable the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] security systems and enable Kenobi to join him on the craft.<ref name="Captured">''[[The Clone Wars: Captured]]''</ref> In order to make his ruse appear convincing, Skywalker intentionally damaged [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his Delta-7B starfighter]] with assistance from his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. [[General/Legends|General]] Skywalker then planned to be dropped off in his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] from his personal ship, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], in an [[Unidentified ice field/Legends|ice field]], where the Confederate [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] would find him and pull him aboard.<ref name="Bait" />

==The operation==
{{Quote|For all your expertise, this is not a very smooth landing.''"<br />"''If you'd hit that second fighter, we wouldn't be in this mess.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, during their crash-landing on Vanqor|<ref name="Dooku Captured" />}}
[[File:Skywalker_as_bait.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker fights battle droids aboard Dooku's frigate.]]
Upon arriving in the [[Water/Legends|ice]] field, Skywalker was deployed in his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Picking up the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] life-sign, the Confederate frigate's [[Unidentified droid captain/Legends|battle droid captain]] ordered the Jedi fighter to be towed aboard. As [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] surrounded the starfighter, Skywalker exited his ship, and, wielding a fake [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], fought the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. After a B2 super battle droid destroyed the Jedi's weapon, the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] apprehended Skywalker,<ref name="Bait" /> placing their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] in one of the frigate's holding cells.<ref name="Dooku Captured" />

While Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], returned with the ''Twilight'' to the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]],<ref name="Bait" /> Kenobi donned a [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]] to protect himself from the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and infiltrated Dooku's frigate, which was in space near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]].<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> Thanks to Skywalker's deactivation of the ship's security systems, Kenobi was able to board the ship through a hatch.<ref name="Captured" /> Kenobi left his suit behind and used a burst of [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] to sneak past a B1 battle droid manning one of the frigate's controls. Kenobi eventually located and freed Skywalker, returning [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] to him,<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> and the two Jedi found Dooku's quarters. As Skywalker and Kenobi confronted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord, the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]&mdash;being commanded by Tano and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]&mdash;opened fire on Dooku's frigate. With his ship outgunned and targeted for boarding,<ref name="Dooku Captured Ep Guide" /> Dooku dropped into an escape hatch and headed to his frigate's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. While Skywalker followed Dooku through the ship's interior, Kenobi left to cut the Sith Lord off in the hangar bay. Dooku shot [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at Skywalker, and although the latter was able to deflect the bolts with his lightsaber, the glare caused him to lose sight of his quarry at a junction where the hatch took two different routes. Dooku arrived in the hangar bay and fled his frigate in his [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class sloop]]. Kenobi entered the room in time to see Dooku depart with a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] escort.<ref name="Dooku Captured" />

Kenobi dispatched several battle droids near a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], stole the [[Shuttle/Legends|vessel]], and was soon joined by Skywalker, who had found his way to the hangar. As the hangar door began to close shut, Skywalker took control of the shuttle and piloted the vessel out of the frigate in time to avoid being trapped. Kenobi told Tano to follow in whatever reinforcements she could find. Pursuing Dooku, Kenobi managed to land a shot on Dooku's [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]], forcing the [[Count/Legends|count]] to crash-land on Vanqor. As the Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] attacked the Jedi's stolen shuttle, Kenobi returned fire on the enemy fighters, but one of the droids hit the shuttle. The Jedi were forced to crash-land on Vanqor as well. Upon finding Dooku's ship with the Sith Lord nowhere in sight, Skywalker destroyed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] that Dooku had activated to call for help. Continuing their search for the Sith Lord, the pair of Jedi Generals entered a cave, [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] Dooku's presence, among several other lifeforms. Using their lightsabers for illumination, Skywalker and Kenobi looked for Dooku before the Sith Lord himself began a rockfall above the two Jedi. Kenobi jumped out of the way in time, but Skywalker was trapped beneath the stalactites. Dooku stole Skywalker's lightsaber and [[Telekinesis/Legends|caused]] an avalanche as he left the cave, blocking the cavern entrance with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Dooku Captured" />

As Skywalker freed himself from the rocks and found Kenobi, a [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] beast appeared and attacked Skywalker.<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> Because Kenobi's lightsaber had been rendered defunct with its [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] knocked loose,<ref name="Dooku Captured Decoded">{{TCW|Dooku Captured|d=y}}</ref> he and Skywalker pelted rocks at the gundark with the Force, and the creature was eventually crushed. While telekinetically moving rocks to form a barrier between themselves and the fallen gundark, the two Jedi accidentally opened a fissure in the cave, releasing toxic gas<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> that could kill them within minutes.<ref name="Dooku Captured Decoded" /> Attempting to clear the blocked cavern entrance, Skywalker and Kenobi collapsed from the effects of the gas. The duo were saved when Tano and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;who had arrived on Vanqor aboard a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]]&mdash;blasted the entrance open. The explosion repelled the gas, and Skywalker and Kenobi were able to escape from the cave. With the two Jedi Generals freed, Tano ordered the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to seal the entrance once more as the gundark returned.<ref name="Dooku Captured" /><ref name="Number of gundarks" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We've reestablished contact with Kenobi and Skywalker. They're in a system close to Florrum.''"<br />"''And most eager to find Dooku they are.|Mace Windu and Yoda|<ref name="Dooku Captured" />}}
[[File:Epguide11.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi meet with the captured Dooku.]]
While the Jedi were occupied with fighting the gundark, a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] tricked Count Dooku into traveling to the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to escape the "dangers" that befell Vanqor after nightfall. On Florrum, the pirates managed to take Dooku hostage and took him to [[Hondo's complex/Legends|their outpost]]. Contacting [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]&mdash;the [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of the pirate band&mdash;set Dooku's ransom at one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] requested that two Jedi be allowed to verify that Dooku was in the pirates' captivity so that the Republic could finally apprehend the Sith Lord. Since Skywalker and Kenobi were in a [[Star system/Legends|system]] close to Florrum, Jedi Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assigned the two to the [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|mission]]. The two Jedi Generals took the ''Twilight'' to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet.<ref name="Dooku Captured" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish at Vanqor first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Bait]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], and was featured in "[[Dooku Captured]]," the [[January]] [[2009]] episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series into which the online comic led.<ref name="Dooku Captured Ep Guide" />
